title: 법원 감사위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Meetings)
(1) Regular meetings of the Committee shall be held once every quarter and convened by the chairperson.
(2) Extraordinary meetings of the Committee shall be convened by the chairperson where deemed necessary by the chairperson or upon request by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court or at least one third of its incumbent members.
(3) The Committee shall commence deliberations at a meeting attended by a majority of its incumbent members and shall adopt resolutions with the affirmative vote of a majority of the members present.
(4) Meetings shall not be open to the public.
(5) The secretary shall record the course of proceedings and a summary of the contents of a meeting in the minutes, which shall be signed or sealed by the chairperson and secretary.
